Cookie policy

How the Visun AI website uses cookies and similar local storage technologies.

Updated: 14 September 2026

1. Current status

The current frontend does not install advertising cookies, behavioural analytics cookies or third-party tracking tools. Navigation and the contact experience work without cookies.

2. Future website upgrades

If Visun AI adds analytics, chat, embedded video or marketing systems that use cookies, this policy and the visitor choice mechanism will be updated before those tools are enabled.

3. Essential cookies

Technical cookies may later be used to maintain security, session state or privacy preferences. They will support only functions necessary for the website to operate.

4. Browser controls

You may review, block or delete cookies in your browser settings. Blocking essential cookies may affect some functions if they are introduced later.

5. Contact

Questions about cookies can be sent to infor.visun@gmail.com.
